classification: Four reviewed analytic theorems: same-source weighted covariance and actual-cell upper, cubic certificate strengthening, and fixed-cap repair-rate obstruction; original convergence OPEN
conclusions: An attained diagonal majorizer D of the literal complete signing K yields an exact unit-variance PSD cross covariance of operator norm below three, with no modification of A,-A or cross drift B.

Under a fixed original norm cap, the full weighted Hermite correction and shifted-sign comparison give expected ORIGINAL norm error O(n^(16/11)); this yields the correctly directed floor for every actual conditional cross optimizer.
Actual weighted triples give PSD linear comparison fields. Real parameter bins and original integer shells produce a polynomial actual-cell reduction with O(n sqrt(log n)) total selection error.

The same D majorizes the ORIGINAL cross form H_B. Equation (4.6) in the weighted-shell note is a genuine all-actual-cell upper with exact two-trace width, retaining distinct weighted feedback and unweighted drift.

For finite scalar-optimal templates tau(C)=p q, cubic matched-frame alignment proves q>=12/5 implies Gamma(C)>283/200>sqrt(2). This clears the stated weak-Dirac diagnostic in the remaining certificate range without identifying actual Boolean norm with Gamma.

For every fixed cap C>1/2, actual complete sources have tensor positive-part Gaussian repair cost of order at least n^(3/2)/sqrt(K) along unbounded thresholds and arbitrarily large orders at each threshold, for both tensor signs and after symmetric restriction and diagonal removal.
not_proved: A sharp evaluation of the weighted all-actual-cell upper using original or conditional optimality.
Vanishing or favorably signed weighted/unweighted Delta_B and internal Delta_A compatibility errors under the norm or trace cap alone.
Small canonical SDP gap for actual original or conditional minimizers; follow-on gap investigations are not in this package.
Equality of the finite-template Gamma upper certificate with general actual nonsymmetric Boolean norm.
The fixed-cap repair obstruction at C=1/2, on exact original minimizers, or for the full coupled cross covariance.
The sharp conditional dyadic inequality, original all-orders convergence or nonconvergence, or an identified limit value.
next_target: Evaluate the weighted-shell note's (4.6) on ACTUAL coupled original/weighted cells, retaining or proving control of (5.3)-(5.6); use original/conditional optimality without assuming all diagonals scalar or all SDP gaps small.
